v.t: By the spreaders spreading
v.l: Wa Adh-Dhariyati Dharwan

v.t: And those carrying loads
v.l: Falhamilati Wiqraan

v.t: And those moving gently
v.l: Faljariyati Yusraan

v.t: And those distributing as commanded
v.l: Falmuqassimati 'Amraan

v.t: What you are promised is true
v.l: Innama Tu`aduna Lasadiqun

v.t: Judgment will take place
v.l: Wa 'Inna Ad-Dina Lawaqi`un

v.t: By the sky that is woven
v.l: Wa As-Sama'i Dhati Al-Hubuki

v.t: You differ in what you say
v.l: Innakum Lafi Qawlin Mukhtalifin

v.t: Averted from it is he who is averted
v.l: Yu'ufaku `Anhu Man 'Ufika

v.t: Perish the imposters
v.l: Qutila Al-Kharrasuna

v.t: Those who are dazed in ignorance
v.l: Al-Ladhina Hum Fi Ghamratin Sahuna

v.t: They ask, “When is the Day of Judgment?”
v.l: Yas'aluna 'Ayyana Yawmu Ad-Dini

v.t: The Day they are presented to the Fire
v.l: Yawma Hum `Ala An-Nari Yuftanuna

v.t: “Taste your ordeal. This is what you used to challenge.”
v.l: Dhuqu Fitnatakum Hadha Al-Ladhi Kuntum Bihi Tasta`jiluna

v.t: But the pious are amidst gardens and springs
v.l: Inna Al-Muttaqina Fi Jannatin Wa `Uyunin

v.t: Receiving what their Lord has given them. They were virtuous before that
v.l: Akhidhina Ma 'Atahum Rabbuhum 'Innahum Kanu Qabla Dhalika Muhsinina

v.t: They used to sleep a little at night
v.l: Kanu Qalilaan Mina Al-Layli Ma Yahja`una

v.t: And at dawn, they would pray for pardon
v.l: Wa Bil-'Ashari Hum Yastaghfiruna
w: And in the hours before dawn

v.t: And in their wealth, there was a share for the beggar and the deprived
v.l: Wa Fi 'Amwalihim Haqqun Lilssa'ili Wa Al-Mahrumi

v.t: And on earth are signs for the convinced
v.l: Wa Fi Al-'Arđi 'Ayatun Lilmuqinina

v.t: And within yourselves. Do you not see
v.l: Wa Fi 'Anfusikum 'Afala Tubsiruna

v.t: And in the heaven is your livelihood, and what you are promised
v.l: Wa Fi As-Sama'i Rizqukum Wa Ma Tu`aduna

v.t: By the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is as true as the fact that you speak
v.l: Fawarabbi As-Sama'i Wa Al-'Arđi 'Innahu Lahaqqun Mithla Ma 'Annakum Tantiquna

v.t: Has the story of Abraham’s honorable guests reached you
v.l: Hal 'Ataka Hadithu Đayfi 'Ibrahima Al-Mukramina

v.t: When they entered upon him, they said, “Peace.” He said, “Peace, strangers.”
v.l: Idh Dakhalu `Alayhi Faqalu Salamaan Qala Salamun Qawmun Munkaruna

v.t: Then he slipped away to his family, and brought a fatted calf
v.l: Faragha 'Ila 'Ahlihi Faja'a Bi`ijlin Saminin

v.t: He set it before them. He said, “Will you not eat?”
v.l: Faqarrabahu 'Ilayhim Qala 'Ala Ta'kuluna

v.t: And he harbored fear of them. They said, “Do not fear,” and they announced to him the good news of a knowledgeable boy
v.l: Fa'awjasa Minhum Khifatan Qalu La Takhaf Wa Basharuhu Bighulamin `Alimin
w: and they gave him glad tidings

v.t: His wife came forward crying. She clasped her face, and said, “A barren old woman?”
v.l: Fa'aqbalati Amra'atuhu Fi Sarratin Fasakkat Wajhaha Wa Qalat `Ajuzun `Aqimun

v.t: They said, “Thus spoke your Lord. He is the Wise, the Knowing.”
v.l: Qalu Kadhaliki Qala Rabbuki 'Innahu Huwa Al-Hakimu Al-`Alimu

v.t: He said, “What is your business, O envoys?”
v.l: Qala Fama Khatbukum 'Ayyuha Al-Mursaluna

v.t: They said, “We are sent to a people guilty of sin.”
v.l: Qalu 'Inna 'Ursilna 'Ila Qawmin Mujrimina

v.t: “To unleash upon them rocks of clay.”
v.l: Linursila `Alayhim Hijaratan Min Tinin

v.t: “Marked by your Lord for the excessive.”
v.l: Musawwamatan `Inda Rabbika Lilmusrifina

v.t: We evacuated all the believers who were in it
v.l: Fa'akhrajna Man Kana Fiha Mina Al-Mu'uminina

v.t: But found in it only one household of Muslims
v.l: Fama Wajadna Fiha Ghayra Baytin Mina Al-Muslimina

v.t: And We left in it a sign for those who fear the painful punishment
v.l: Wa Tarakna Fiha 'Ayatan Lilladhina Yakhafuna Al-`Adhaba Al-'Alima

v.t: And in Moses. We sent him to Pharaoh with a clear authority
v.l: Wa Fi Musa 'Idh 'Arsalnahu 'Ila Fir`awna Bisultanin Mubinin

v.t: But he turned away with his warlords, and said, “A sorcerer or a madman.”
v.l: Fatawalla Biruknihi Wa Qala Sahirun 'Aw Majnunun

v.t: So We seized him and his troops, and threw them into the sea, and He was to blame
v.l: Fa'akhadhnahu Wa Junudahu Fanabadhnahum Fi Al-Yammi Wa Huwa Mulimun

v.t: And in Aad. We unleashed against them the devastating wind
v.l: Wa Fi `Adin 'Idh 'Arsalna `Alayhimu Ar-Riha Al-`Aqima

v.t: It spared nothing it came upon, but rendered it like decayed ruins
v.l: Ma Tadharu Min Shay'in 'Atat `Alayhi 'Illa Ja`alat/hu Kalrramimi

v.t: And in Thamood. They were told, “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”
v.l: Wa Fi Thamuda 'Idh Qila Lahum Tamatta`u Hatta Hinin

v.t: But they defied the command of their Lord, so the lightning struck them as they looked on
v.l: Fa`ataw `An 'Amri Rabbihim Fa'akhadhat/humu As-Sa`iqatu Wa Hum Yanzuruna

v.t: They could not rise up, nor could they find help
v.l: Fama Astata`u Min Qiyamin Wa Ma Kanu Muntasirina

v.t: And before that, the people of Noah. They were immoral people
v.l: Wa Qawma Nuhin Min Qablu 'Innahum Kanu Qawmaan Fasiqina

v.t: We constructed the universe with power, and We are expanding it
v.l: Wa As-Sama'a Banaynaha Bi'ayydin Wa 'Inna Lamusi`una

v.t: And the earth—We spread it out—How well We prepared it
v.l: Wa Al-'Arđa Farashnaha Fani`ma Al-Mahiduna

v.t: We created all things in pairs, so that you may reflect and ponder
v.l: Wa Min Kulli Shay'in Khalaqna Zawjayni La`allakum Tadhakkaruna

v.t: “So flee towards God. I am to you from Him a clear warner.”
v.l: Fafirru 'Ila Allahi 'Inni Lakum Minhu Nadhirun Mubinun

v.t: “And do not set up any other god with God. I am to you from Him a clear warner.”
v.l: Wa La Taj`alu Ma`a Allahi 'Ilahaan 'Akhara 'Inni Lakum Minhu Nadhirun Mubinun

v.t: Likewise, no messenger came to those before them, but they said, “A sorcerer or a madman.”
v.l: Kadhalika Ma 'Ata Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Min Rasulin 'Illa Qalu Sahirun 'Aw Majnunun

v.t: Did they recommend it to one another? In fact, they are rebellious people
v.l: Atawasaw Bihi Bal Hum Qawmun Taghuna
w: Have they transmitted it to them
Have they transmitted it to them

v.t: So turn away from them; you are not to blame
v.l: Fatawalla `Anhum Fama 'Anta Bimalumin

v.t: And remind, for the reminder benefits the believers
v.l: Wa Dhakkir Fa'inna Adh-Dhikra Tanfa`u Al-Mu'uminina

v.t: I did not create the jinn and the humans except to worship Me
v.l: Wa Ma Khalaqtu Al-Jinna Wa Al-'Insa 'Illa Liya`buduni

v.t: I need no livelihood from them, nor do I need them to feed Me
v.l: Ma 'Uridu Minhum Min Rizqin Wa Ma 'Uridu 'An Yut`imuni

v.t: God is the Provider, the One with Power, the Strong
v.l: Inna Allaha Huwa Ar-Razzaqu Dhu Al-Quwati Al-Matinu

v.t: Those who do wrong will have their turn, like the turn of their counterparts, so let them not rush Me
v.l: Fa'inna Lilladhina Zalamu Dhanubaan Mithla Dhanubi 'Ashabihim Fala Yasta`jiluni
w: so let them not ask Me to hasten
so let them not ask Me to hasten

v.t: So woe to those who disbelieve because of that Day of theirs which they are promised
v.l: Fawaylun Lilladhina Kafaru Min Yawmihimu Al-Ladhi Yu`aduna
